scope: Actual cached primary-source review plus terminal RPC attempts; no admission, prediction, metrics, or study publication

source_review.reason: Both separately attributed security publishers identify the same exact attack execution and provide distinct technical analyses. CertiK traces the 2022 bug-bounty redesign, split-level Vault/ShortsTracker updates and detailed arithmetic; Verichains separately dissects fallback control, order/position loops and low initial short interest. Their common mechanism is reentrant direct Vault entry during keeper execution causing inconsistent short-price accounting and inflated GLP redemption. This is more than domain separation or title agreement; no cross-attribution to each other appears. Public evidence does not prove separate investigative tooling or human reviewer independence.
